description: nox reviews a code diff — or a plan artifact — under a different AI harness than the one that wrote it, headlessly. The review never runs in your checkout. nox builds a pair of synthetic commits with every instruction file, hook, credential and agent-config file neutralized in the tree, checks the target out into an ephemeral git worktree it owns, and spawns the reviewing harness there under a minimal environment — so the reviewer sees the change and not the repository's own instructions. Ships the skill plus a zero-dependency Python zipapp it shells to; findings come back as prose, stamped untrusted.
name: nox
summary: Adversarial review of a diff or a plan artifact under a second AI harness
